description: Delete items from a collection, either by explicit IDs or by a query. Providing neither deletes nothing. Since Directus 12.4 a query resolves its targets under the token's read permissions: read access to the primary key is required and only readable items are deleted.

query.description: Directus query selecting the items to delete, e.g. { "filter": { "status": { "_eq": "archived" } } }. Mutually exclusive with ids. Use { "limit": -1 } to deliberately target every item.

name: delete_items
